description: The bar chart illustrates five different distributions—labeled Increasing, Uniform, Decreasing, Spindle, and Bottleneck—each represented by a series of adjacent vertical bars of varying heights. The horizontal axis displays these five distribution types, each with a distinct pattern of bar heights. The vertical axis, which represents the value or frequency, is not explicitly labeled with numerical values or units, but the relative heights of the bars within each group convey the distribution shape. In the "Increasing" distribution, the bars progressively increase in height from left to right. The "Uniform" distribution shows bars of approximately equal height. The "Decreasing" distribution displays bars that decrease in height from left to right. The "Spindle" distribution has a central peak with bars decreasing in height on both sides. The "Bottleneck" distribution features a low height in the middle, with higher bars on the left and right sides. The bars are light green with a darker green outline, and the overall layout is a series of five distinct histograms arranged side-by-side.
